content.description: Illustration showing removal of pulsation damper and No. 1 fuel pipe from engine

content.text: 11. REMOVE PULSATION DAMPER AND NO. 1 FUEL PIPE

items: (a) Loosen the clamp and disconnect the water by-pass hose.
(b) Remove the two bolts and remove the outlet housing.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of intake manifold with eight bolts and two nuts locations

content.text: Remove the eight bolts and two nuts holding the intake manifold and remove the intake manifold and gasket.

content.description: Illustration showing power steering pump removal from bracket

content.text: 14. REMOVE POWER STEERING PUMP FROM BRACKET

items: (a) Remove the PS pump pulley with the drive belt.
(c) Remove the PS pump from the bracket.
(d) Lay the PS pump to one side without disconnecting the hoses.

content.description: Illustration showing exhaust manifold with five nuts and two heat insulators marked

items: (a) Remove the five nuts and the two heat insulators.
(b) Remove seven nuts and the exhaust manifold.

content.text: 16. REMOVE TIMING BELT AND CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEYS (See steps 9 to 13 on page EM-12)

content.description: Illustration showing oil pressure regulator and timing belt cover stay removal

items: (a) Remove the two bolts and the timing belt cover stay.
(b) Remove the three bolts and the oil pressure regulator and gasket.

content.text: Remove the three bolts and two nuts and the No. 2 timing belt cover and gasket.
